name: Console Preamp
author: Airwindows (Chris Johnson, MIT licence)
description: Airwindows Mackity by Chris Johnson: the sound of a small-format console's preamp - a tight low end, a soft top and grit when pushed. Ported from Airwindows (MIT licence).
code:
// Airwindows Mackity, Copyright (c) 2018 Chris Johnson, MIT licence (LICENSE-airwindows.txt) - ported to Central FX
@init
os = srate / 44100
iA = 0.001860867 / os
iB = 0.000287496 / os
K = tan(pi * 19160 / srate)
qa = 0.431684981684982
n = 1 / (1 + K / qa + K * K)
a0 = K * K * n; a1 = 2 * a0; a3 = 2 * (K * K - 1) * n; a4 = (1 - K / qa + K * K) * n
qb = 1.1582298
n = 1 / (1 + K / qb + K * K)
b0 = K * K * n; b1 = 2 * b0; b3 = 2 * (K * K - 1) * n; b4 = (1 - K / qb + K * K) * n
@block
tr = db2gain(drive)
tr = tr * tr
go = db2gain(output)
@sample
n = noise() * 1e-17
x = inL + n
jAL += (x - jAL) * iA
x = (x - jAL) * tr
o = a0 * (x + xa2L) + a1 * xa1L - a3 * ya1L - a4 * ya2L
xa2L = xa1L; xa1L = x; ya2L = ya1L; ya1L = o
x = clamp(o, -1, 1)
x2 = x * x
x -= x2 * x2 * x * 0.1768
o = b0 * (x + xb2L) + b1 * xb1L - b3 * yb1L - b4 * yb2L
xb2L = xb1L; xb1L = x; yb2L = yb1L; yb1L = o
jBL += (o - jBL) * iB
outL = (o - jBL) * go
y = inR + n
jAR += (y - jAR) * iA
y = (y - jAR) * tr
o = a0 * (y + xa2R) + a1 * xa1R - a3 * ya1R - a4 * ya2R
xa2R = xa1R; xa1R = y; ya2R = ya1R; ya1R = o
y = clamp(o, -1, 1)
y2 = y * y
y -= y2 * y2 * y * 0.1768
o = b0 * (y + xb2R) + b1 * xb1R - b3 * yb1R - b4 * yb2R
xb2R = xb1R; xb1R = y; yb2R = yb1R; yb1R = o
jBR += (o - jBR) * iB
outR = (o - jBR) * go
